key_insight: JustOPD adapts on-policy distillation to transfer reasoning ability from a strong autoregressive teacher to a diffusion language model by using autoregressive rollouts during training.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical route to improve DLM mathematical reasoning without sacrificing their flexible generation-order inference behavior.
method: Train the DLM student on sequences sampled from its own policy during distillation.
Use autoregressive rollouts to align the student’s training trajectory with the teacher’s left-to-right decoding.
Support multiple divergence objectives while distilling from Qwen3-14B to Dream-7B.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent mathematical reasoning gains over the base DLM across multiple divergence choices in experiments with Qwen3-14B as teacher and Dream-7B as student.
watch_item: Performance depends on successful alignment between AR teacher rollouts and the DLM training process, which may add implementation complexity and still leave teacher-student mismatch issues.
paper_title: JustOPD: On-Policy Distillation from Autoregressive to Diffusion Language Models
